ships.label: Small Cog
ships.identificationNotes: Broad little hull with a simple square-sail profile.

ships.label: Dhow
ships.identificationNotes: Lateen sail and narrow hull read strongly as an Indian Ocean or Red Sea craft.

ships.label: Sampan
ships.identificationNotes: Small Chinese-rigged vessel; good for river/coastal Asian traffic.

ships.label: Pirate Brig
ships.identificationNotes: Black-sailed multi-mast raider; brig is the cleanest game label.

ships.label: Galleon
ships.identificationNotes: Tall stern and large square-rigged profile.

ships.label: Fluyt
ships.identificationNotes: Bulky merchant hull, useful as a cargo specialist.

ships.label: Ship of the Line
ships.identificationNotes: Largest heavy square-rigger in the pack.

ships.label: Small Carrack
ships.identificationNotes: Roundship profile, larger than a cog but less imposing than the carrack.

ships.label: Ketch
ships.identificationNotes: Stylized enough that this is a functional label more than a firm identification.

ships.label: Brigantine
ships.identificationNotes: Medium square/fore-and-aft trader or light naval vessel.

ships.label: Lateen Dhow
ships.identificationNotes: Curved lateen silhouette; good Indian Ocean/Arabian Sea craft.

ships.label: Square-Sail Trader
ships.identificationNotes: Simple small trader with square-sail read.

ships.label: Dhow-Felucca
ships.identificationNotes: Another small lateen craft; distinct source model from Felucca.
